channel.title: New Jersey Monitor - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Jersey Monitor (newjerseymonitor.com)

item.title: Federal judges, Trump administration agree on new US attorney for NJ
item.description: New Jersey's federal judges appointed career prosecutor Robert Frazer to lead the U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of New Jersey after previous heads were found to be unlawfully installed.

item.title: Protesters rally against illegal immigration in Trenton ahead of vote on key bills
item.description: About 100 people rallied outside the Statehouse against legislation meant to protect New Jersey immigrants from the feds' immigration crackdown.

item.title: Supreme Court skeptical of allowing states to count mail ballots that arrive after Election Day
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court’s conservative justices on Monday appeared skeptical of the validity of mail-in ballots that arrive after Election Day.

item.title: Analilia Mejia refusing to debate Joe Hathaway is bad for voters
item.description: Analilia Mejia, a Democrat hoping to win election to the House next month, won’t participate in a League of Women Voters debate. That’s a mistake.

item.title: NJ Assembly passes state Voting Rights Act
item.description: The bill would create a voting rights division within the state Treasury and give the office broad oversight powers over election administration in some towns.

item.title: NJ Legislature approves trio of immigration bills in divided votes
item.description: Democrats said the bills would protect immigrants from the president’s mass deportation effort. Republicans said they prioritize politics over public safety.

item.title: Airport chaos: TSA agents skip work, security lines expand, Trump sends in ICE to assist
item.description: Airport security workers missed work Monday at the highest rate since a partial government shutdown began in mid-February, the Department of Homeland Security said.

item.title: US Senate confirms Mullin as next Homeland Security boss
item.description: The U.S. Senate voted Monday evening to confirm Markwayne Mullin to lead the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: NJ state police sued for keeping retired cops’ gun carry permits a secret
item.description: A gun rights advocate says the state's refusal to release data on retired cops with carry permits guns hides the true scope of gun carry in New Jersey.

item.title: Lawsuit alleges Assembly speaker’s law firm violated family leave law
item.description: A former paralegal at Assembly Speaker Craig Coughlin’s law firm alleges she was fired for requesting family leave to care for a loved one.
